tools.description: Reads the public DNS of one domain and reports SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, MTA-STS and TLS-RPT findings, risks, unknowns and the exact DNS changes to fix them. Read-only; nothing is stored.
tools.name: checkDomain
tools.title: Check email authentication of a domain

tools.description: Runs the email-authentication check of one domain and returns a machine-readable, NON-BINDING quote for Fix & Verify: price (EUR 99 net per domain), scope (exact DNS changes), acceptance criteria and the baseline to verify against later. Orders are not open: it creates no order, contract or payment and stores nothing. Keep the returned criteria and baseline to call verifyFixVerify after the records are published.
tools.name: quoteFixVerify
tools.title: Scope and quote Fix & Verify for a domain

tools.description: Re-runs the check of the domain and compares it with the acceptance criteria and baseline of an earlier quoteFixVerify result: PASS when every criterion is resolved and no new critical or high finding appeared. Read-only; nothing is stored; a pass is not an invoice while orders are closed.
tools.name: verifyFixVerify
tools.title: Verify a Fix & Verify scope after the DNS change
